messages:
Priya: Quick brainstorm: launch a compact OSS refapp + 20-min live lab. KPI: repo stars (target 500) + 200 signups. Short, actionable content.
Alex: Love that. Keep tutorial to a single runnable folder with Dockerfile and one-line start. Include a GIF for quick consumption.
Marco: I'll handle micro-benchmarks. Plan: run seq 512/1024, batch 1/16, capture p50/p95 and tok/s. Export results as CSV to `bench/`.
Priya: Marketing ops: need HubSpot form with utm_source=refapp_lab, tag=oss_refapp. Create nurture flow for small companies and SDR handoff for enterprise.
Alex: Messaging split: "Try a tiny inference refapp in 10 minutes" for socials, and "See real numbers: save on inference" for newsletter. A/B test subject lines.
Marco: Bench CLI example for README:
```bash
python bench.py --model redwood-medium --seq 1024 --batch 16 --metrics p50,p95,toks/s --out bench/results.csv
```
ops-bot: Scheduled reminder: publish checklist due 2026-08-01.
Priya: Timeline: Week1 repo + tutorial draft. Week2 bench + landing page. Week3 publish + open signups. Week4 webinar + follow-ups. Owners: Alex (repo/tutorial), Marco (bench), Priya (landing/email). Please ack. :thumbsup:
Alex: ack
Marco: ack
